newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Slots review and air alliance probes separate - EU.
newsitem.headline: Slots review and air alliance probes separate - EU.

text.p: European Commission efforts to revise slot allocation rules are not linked to its probes into a series of transatlantic aviation alliances, spokesman Constantin Verros said on Friday.
Verros said internal discussions continued within the Commission to strike a compromise on rules governing the allocation of airport landing and take-off slots.
"I have to stress that they do not have any link at all to any alliances which are being discussed for the time being, be it BA/American or other alliances," Verros told a news conference.

The Commission said last July it was looking into a series of alliances including Britsh Airways's plans to link up with AMR Corp's American Airlines and existing agreements between Delta Air Lines/Sabena /Swissair/ / Austrian Airlines, between Lufthansa /United Airlines /Scandinavian Airlines System and between KLM and Northwest Airlines.
